## Global States and Properties

Some states and properties are applicable to all host language elements regardless of whether a role is applied.

- [`aria-disabled (state)`](../attributes/aria-disabled.md) (Global use deprecated in ARIA 1.2)
- [`aria-errormessage`](../attributes/aria-errormessage.md) (Global use deprecated in ARIA 1.2)
- [`aria-label`](../attributes/aria-label.md) (Except where prohibited)
